ce_bugs.text: Migration's check `embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0` is always false for SELECT queries, making the migration code dead and causing all existing embeddable_hosts site settings to be deleted with no replacement rows created (data loss)
Migration INSERT interpolates raw host values without escaping, causing SQL syntax errors or SQL injection when values contain single quotes
AJAX errors are silently swallowed on host delete and embedding save because destroyRecord and update calls lack .catch(popupAjaxError) error handling
After host.save, the client unconditionally sets host.category from possibly-null categoryId, overwriting the server-hydrated category with undefined and blanking the badge until page reload

topic.rb expandable_first_post? no longer short-circuits on empty embeddable_hosts, causing a per-topic has_topic_embed? (TopicEmbed.where(...).exists?) N+1 query during topic-list serialization for sites with embed_truncate enabled

Validation regex permits hosts with :port suffix (e.g. example.com:8080) to be persisted, but record_for_host looks up by uri.host (never containing a port), so stored hosts with ports can never be matched by host_allowed?

Migration copies old site setting values into embeddable_hosts without stripping http(s):// scheme or paths, so previously-working embeds like 'https://example.com/1234' will never match record_for_host and ensure_embeddable will raise InvalidAccess after upgrade

Validation regex permits host:port (example.com:8080) but record_for_host compares uri.host (no port) against stored value, so port-bearing entries never match and port-bearing referers match bare-host records — validation and lookup contract mismatch
Migration's execute(...)[0]['id'] will raise on a nil row when no matching category exists, failing the migration on fresh installs where the setting was never customized

Migration interpolates untrusted legacy embeddable_hosts setting values directly into SQL, causing migration failure on SQL metacharacters and an admin-gated SQL-injection vector (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:22-25)

Migration stores legacy hosts unnormalized (e.g., 'http://eviltrout.com') while new EmbeddableHost.record_for_host compares against uri.host only, so existing embedding setups silently break after upgrade (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:20-27)

AdminEmbeddableHostsController update/destroy crash with NoMethodError (500) when the host id is unknown instead of returning a 404/validation error (app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:11-19)

Frontend host delete destroyRecord().then() has no .catch, so DELETE failures leave the row silently stuck with an unhandled promise rejection (app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:43-49)

Host entries with a port (e.g., example.com:8080) pass validation but can never match record_for_host's uri.host comparison, a functional regression vs. old behavior; port should be stripped in before_validation or host+port compared (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:4, 12-19)

Store _hydrateEmbedded plural path can insert null entries into hydrated arrays when a sub-record id isn't resolvable, potentially causing downstream errors (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6:192-208)
update and destroy in embeddable_hosts_controller call .first on lookup and then methods on result; nonexistent id causes NoMethodError and 500 with no test coverage
Hosts stored with ports never match referers because record_for_host uses uri.host without port while validation allows port-included hosts; untested
Data migration interpolates raw strings into SQL without escaping, so a host value containing a quote breaks or corrupts the migration
Store hydration 'find embedded' test is coupled to a pretender route that returns fruits[0] regardless of the requested id
Migration does not normalize migrated hosts (strips protocols), so existing configured hosts like 'http://eviltrout.com' silently stop matching and lose embedding access after upgrade
Migration interpolates setting values directly into INSERT statement, making it SQL-injection/breakage-prone — a stored value containing a quote raises and fails the migration
EmbeddableHostsController#destroy calls host.destroy without a nil check, raising NoMethodError and returning 500 for stale/invalid ids

Migration crashes with NoMethodError on execute(...)[0]['id'] when the embed_category site setting row is absent (site_settings rows only exist for overridden values), aborting the upgrade; the same crash-on-empty pattern exists at line 15 for uncategorized_category_id

Unescaped string interpolation of host value h into the INSERT statement at migration line 25 — a single quote causes a syntax error killing the migration, and it's a SQL-injection vector; should use quote(h) or the model layer

Backfill inserts raw host setting lines (with http:// scheme / paths) without normalization, so EmbeddableHost.record_for_host comparing lower(host) = URI(host).host will never match, silently breaking embedding for all sites that entered hosts with a scheme after upgrade

Category mapping resolved by exact name match (s.value = c.name) is lossy: renamed categories or duplicate names cause a silent fallback to Uncategorized, and since the legacy setting is deleted the original mapping is unrecoverable
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update and #destroy raise NoMethodError (500) when the host id doesn't exist instead of returning 404
Migration crashes on installs without 'embed_category' in site_settings: SELECT returns zero rows, so [0] is nil and nil['id'] raises TypeError, blocking the deploy
Fallback branch in migration has the same nil['value'] crash for uncategorized_category_id but is unreachable because the crash happens earlier
Behavioral change: any topic with a TopicEmbed row is now expandable whenever embed_truncate is on, even with zero hosts configured
Store hydration plural branch destructively rewrites _ids keys even when _lookupSubType returns undefined, replacing real payload data with an array of undefined
Hosts saved with a port can never match in record_for_host because it compares against uri.host which excludes the port, so the admin's setting silently does nothing
EmbeddingController#update performs no persistence but renders a success payload, making PUT /customize/embedding a silent no-op save path trusted by client saveChanges()
Admin embeddable_hosts_controller update/destroy lack a presence check on the found record, so stale/concurrently-deleted IDs cause NoMethodError and a 500 instead of a 404
save_host calls params[:embeddable_host][:host] with no nil check, causing a 500 if the payload key is missing
delete() in embeddable-host.js.es6 has no .catch(popupAjaxError) on destroyRecord(), so failed deletes produce no user-facing error and the row silently stays in the list
before_validation crashes with NoMethodError on nil host because self.host.sub! is called before validation runs

mrv_findings.text: Migration crashes with NoMethodError on every site where 'embed_category' setting was never set (default ''), because the SQL join matches zero rows and [0] is nil
Migration matches category by name via site setting value, so a renamed category causes hosts to silently fall back to uncategorized

Migration interpolates host values directly into SQL INSERT statements, so any host string containing a quote raises a SQL error, aborting the migration after the table is created but before site settings cleanup
No spec covers the migration in any of its paths, including the acceptance criterion that settings survive the migration
Admin embeddable hosts controller destroy/update call methods on nil when the record is already deleted (race/double-click/stale tab), causing NoMethodError 500 instead of a 404/success_json
The delete() client action has no .catch, so the user gets no feedback on failure

Validation regex permits hosts with ports (example.com:8080) but record_for_host compares uri.host (no port) against stored value, so hosts saved with a port can never match and embedding silently fails
No spec covers a host-with-port; fabricators and specs only use bare hostnames
The two fabricator files' contents are swapped: category_fabricator.rb contains the embeddable_host fabricator and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains category fabricators
Admin embeddable hosts controller spec only asserts controller inheritance; nothing tests create/update/destroy round-trip or the uncategorized fallback in save_host

Admin::EmbeddingController#update just re-renders the fetch and mutates nothing, while the client wires saveChanges() to embedding.update({}), so the 'save changes' requirement is not actually implemented and untested

EmbeddingSerializer uses embed: :ids for embeddable_hosts, so the payload carries only ids without side-loaded host objects, while the client iterates embedding.embeddable_hosts expecting full records, causing the admin page to render undefined/blank hosts
before_validation calls self.host.sub! on a possibly nil host with no presence validation, so a request with host: nil causes a NoMethodError 500 instead of a validation error
Controller reads params[:embeddable_host][:host] without require/permit, so a malformed payload without the embeddable_host key returns a 500 instead of a 400

The contents of spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb and spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb are swapped: the embeddable host fabricator is in category_fabricator.rb and the category fabricators are in embeddable_host_fabricator.rb, causing misfiled work and risk of silently breaking the spec suite when either file is edited or deleted

app/serializers/embedding_serializer.rb:3 uses embed: :ids but the admin UI (embeddable-host.js.es6 and embedding.hbs) expects full host objects with host name, category, and isNew/save methods; hydrating embeddable_host_ids yields records with only an id and no client model for embeddable-host exists, so the table renders empty rows or errors

config/routes.rb:138 and app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:16 define a no-op update endpoint: PUT 'customize/embedding' re-serializes a fetched OpenStruct without persisting anything, the client's saveChanges() sends embedding.update({}), and saveChanges isn't wired to any button, creating a dead save path that implies a save-settings flow that doesn't exist

app/models/topic.rb:869 deletes the embeddable_hosts guard from expandable_first_post? while its test is kept vacuously, so first-post expansion now activates with zero EmbeddableHost rows, changing truncation/expansion behavior independently of configured hosts without stated intent

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:12 crashes with NoMethodError (nil['id']) when the embed_category setting row doesn't exist or its value doesn't match a category name, aborting the upgrade migration; the fallback path also migrates all hosts to Uncategorized, silently discarding previous embed_category targeting
db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb interpolates #{h} values unescaped into the INSERT statement, risking SQL injection or breakage

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:4 vs :16: the validation regex allows ports and before_validation doesn't strip them, so hosts can be saved as example.com:8080, but record_for_host matches on URI#host which excludes the port, so embedding from hosts saved with a port is silently denied

app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:20: a missing host param causes NoMethodError 500 because before_validation calls self.host.sub! on nil (validates_format_of skips nil values), instead of returning a validation error
spec/models/topic_spec.rb:1240-1250 contains unrelated drive-by cleanup of digest specs, adding review noise and obscuring what the PR actually touches

spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb and spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contents are swapped: category_fabricator.rb contains the embeddable_host fabricator while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains the category fabricators, breaking the file-name-to-fabricator correspondence

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb creates the host column with no UNIQUE (or any) index, allowing duplicate rows for the same host and making record_for_host resolve referers to an arbitrary duplicate, making target category assignment nondeterministic

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:16 uses lower(host) matching via URI.host which strips the port from the referer, but the validation regex permits and stores hosts with ports (e.g. example.com:8080), so stored hosts with ports can never match a referer and host_allowed? silently returns false forever

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:3 belongs_to :category has no foreign key constraint and no dependent cleanup path, so deleting the referenced category leaves orphaned category_id values and TopicEmbed.import breaks or lands nowhere silently

app/serializers/embedding_serializer.rb:3 serializes embeddable_hosts with embed: :ids but no side-loaded records are included in the payload, so the admin page's _hydrateEmbedded lookup produces an array of undefined/blank objects in embedding.hbs; also the plural branch lacks the 'if (hydrated)' guard present in the singular branch, making 'hydrated || []' dead code

app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:14-16 update action renders a serialized success payload without persisting anything, creating a phantom save path that reports success on PUT /admin/customize/embedding

spec/models/topic_spec.rb:1401-1404 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' test passes for the wrong reason because production code no longer checks the host and embed_truncate defaults to false, so the named invariant is never exercised

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:11-13 before_validation calls self.host.sub! which raises NoMethodError on nil host, and with no presence validation or param guard in Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host, a missing host produces a 500 instead of a validation error

The admin embedding update endpoint is a no-op: update action renders serialized data without persisting anything, yet it's wired to the route and client saveChanges() call, so callers get a 200 and believe the save succeeded when nothing was written

The data migration is one-way and lossy: it maps old embed_category setting to per-host rows by exact category name match, falls back to uncategorized_category_id on mismatch, then unconditionally deletes the site_settings rows, destroying the original value with no warning if the mapping fails (e.g., slug or renamed category)

topic_embed.rb replaces SiteSetting.embed_category with a category lookup based on record_for_host(url) against the article/feed URL host, while ensure_embeddable authorizes against the referer host, so URL/referer host mismatch or feed_polling_url on a different host yields nil and topics silently land in the default category instead of the previously configured embed_category

topic.rb expandable_first_post? removed the embeddable_hosts.present? guard, so with zero embeddable hosts configured topics with a TopicEmbed row still expand; the rewritten spec no longer tests what it claims (it passes only because embed_truncate defaults to false)

Fabricator files have swapped contents: category_fabricator.rb defines Fabricator(:embeddable_host) while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains all the category fabricator definitions, an unexplained shuffle that will confuse future contributors

embeddable_hosts_controller update and destroy use EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first with no nil guard, causing NoMethodError/500 for stale clients pointing at deleted hosts instead of a 404 or graceful message

The store.js.es6 regex change to /(.+)_id(s?)$/ rewrites payload handling for every model: any *_ids key is deleted and replaced under its pluralized name, silently removing the attribute from hydrated records for consumers that read xxx_ids (e.g., badge_ids, user_ids), a cross-cutting change shipped solely to support singular category_id

SQL string interpolation of untrusted setting value into raw INSERT in db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:22 — host values from the free-text setting are interpolated without parameterization or quoting, causing migration failure on values containing single quotes and enabling SQL injection; fix with parameterized insert/binding

Unguarded destroy on possibly-nil lookup in app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:17-19 — EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first can return nil for a nonexistent id, and calling host.destroy raises NoMethodError resulting in an unhandled 500
Same nil-lookup pattern in the update action of embeddable_hosts_controller.rb — save_host(nil) leads to nil.host= NoMethodError

Fabricator file contents are swapped — spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb defines the embeddable_host fabricator and spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb defines the category fabricator

test/javascripts/helpers/create-pretender.js.es6:228 — the /fruits/:id mock unconditionally returns fruits[0] regardless of the requested id, making the renamed store test a tautology that never exercises id routing or hydration of fruit 2's payload

spec/models/topic_spec.rb:1403 — the 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' test has no setup (no embeddable host fabricate, no embed_truncate setting), so it passes vacuously because embed_truncate? defaults to false, leaving the removed host-gating behavior change with zero test coverage

spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb:3 and spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb:3 — the only tests for the new admin endpoints merely assert controller inheritance and verify no behavior, leaving untested failure modes including EmbeddableHostsController#destroy crashing with NoMethodError on a bad id and Admin::EmbeddingController#update silently not saving

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6:192-204 — the new plural-hydration error path is untested; hydrated is a .map() result so || [] is dead code, unresolvable ids silently produce undefined entries with the original *_ids key deleted (unlike the singular branch which keeps obj[k]), and no test covers an unresolvable color_ids entry

Migration backfill inserts raw, un-normalized host strings, so previously-working scheme-qualified or path-qualified hosts silently stop matching after cutover (raw SQL bypasses the model's before_validation normalization)
Unescaped string interpolation of host values into SQL; any host containing a single quote produces broken SQL and aborts the migration

Migration is irreversible: def change contains non-reversible execute/DELETE steps with no down method, and the DELETE destroys the site_settings source-of-truth rows without any backup/export, breaking rollback and old-code fallback

embed_category backfill assumes the setting stored the category name; if it stored a category ID (or the category was renamed), category_id resolves to 0 and all hosts silently fall back to Uncategorized
Setting removal (contract) and table creation (expand) land in the same deploy step with no compatibility window, causing old pods to error on missing SiteSetting during a rolling deploy
